tasks.short: Review committee bills and recommend their future

steps.what: Locate the actual committee bill version, amendments and supporting evidence and verify the agenda references
Read the actual bill and evidence and judge its consequences, merits and unresolved questions
outputs: actual bill assessment and committee questions

steps.what: Discuss the actual bill in committee and examine testimony and other members' questions
inputs: actual bill assessment and committee questions

steps.what: Explain the legislator's actual recommendation about the bill's future to the committee
inputs: actual bill assessment and committee questions

tasks.design: Link the committee agenda to the exact bill and amendment versions in {OTHER}, the legislative document and committee system, and {DOCS}. The legislator retains substantive reading, deliberation and the actual recommendation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the exact agenda bill and amendment versions can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native agenda/version links remove retrieval without deciding the bill's merits.
tasks.still_hard: Consequences, testimony and competing public interests require accountable political judgment.
tasks.human_edge: The elected member takes responsibility for the actual recommendation.

ambition.what: No automated political recommendation or vote.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: agenda/version links can shorten legislative document retrieval while bill judgment and committee recommendations remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is actual committee review and oral recommendation, not a formal committee report, amendment filing or vote. Any actual written recommendation must have its real writing and separate final-version release, rather than being hidden here.
s1 counts actual agenda/version verification; s2 reads the actual bill and evidence. No clean generated bill summary replaces source reading.
The link removes3 of20 navigation units and retains17 for actual document selection/checks. Existing native committee links earn zero new gain.
No trailing committee note is invented where the legislator does not keep or use one. Official clerk minutes are the clerk's actual work, not a new focal saving. Shares are unmeasured estimates.
research_questions: Which bill-version searches remain manual beyond the native committee portal?

already_counted.description: Actual source checks, full bill reading/judgment, committee discussion and oral recommendation remain counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R97 gives gross3 less upkeep1, net2. Low: a late amendment lacks indexed agenda metadata, retaining19 of20 retrieval units;1 saved covers1 upkeep, net0. Reading and political judgment remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Seek federal funding for local projects

steps.what: Read the actual federal funding opportunity and locate its eligibility, program and timing references for the local project
Examine actual local project and program facts, costs and needs and determine the supported funding case
Prepare and check the actual project funding brief used in the funding discussion

loop.purpose: Suggest factual project-brief prose from the actual supported funding case
loop.input: Checked project facts, costs, program needs and opportunity references
loop.output: Draft project funding brief with source pointers
loop.check: Legislator checks every project claim, amount, program reference and proposed commitment against actual evidence
loop.stop: Two drafts then unsupported claims are removed and remaining preparation stays manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed headings handle structure but expressing the actual project's funding need requires semantic drafting

steps.what: Discuss the actual local project funding need with the responsible federal program contacts and clarify their questions

tasks.design: Link actual program references from {GOV_PORTAL} into the real funding brief in {DOCS}, with costs checked against {SPREADSHEET}. A bounded drafting helper supports factual preparation while the legislator judges the case and conducts the funding discussion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preparing an actual local-project funding discussion can repeat program-reference navigation and brief writing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links and evidence-bound prose suggestions support those preparation actions.
tasks.still_hard: Funding suitability and a defensible local-project case depend on actual facts and program constraints.
tasks.human_edge: The legislator explains the project and takes responsibility for its claims.

ambition.what: No automated lobbying position, funding commitment or application submission.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: program-reference links and bounded factual drafting can support project funding briefs while funding judgment and conversations remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is actual local-project funding preparation and discussion, with a real brief used in that discussion. Do not add a brief to an informal inquiry if nobody keeps or uses one. A formal application, dispatched request or funding commitment needs its real work and separate final-version authority/action.
s1 reads the actual opportunity and s2 checks real project costs and needs; source production belongs to actual project staff and is counted there once. No free new clean funding pack is presumed.

s1 removes3 of20 program-navigation units and retains17 for actual reading and fit checks. s3 retains15 of25 brief-writing/checking units and upkeep includes1 extra manual failed-draft correction unit.

Test current native opportunity links and templates first; existing support earns zero new gain. Ordinary working persistence is negligible within preparation without saving or author self-approval. Shares are unmeasured estimates.
research_questions: Can factual brief preparation be shortened without adding unsupported project or funding claims?

already_counted.description: Actual program reading, project/cost judgment, retained brief writing/checking and funding discussion remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain program/source checks2; manually correct failed brief drafts1.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R87 gives gross13 less upkeep3, net10. Low: a new program requires different project-evidence fields, retaining17.5 of20 reference units and23 of25 brief units;2.5 plus2 saved less3 upkeep gives1.5. Project judgment and funding discussion remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Examine specialized issues on panels and commissions

steps.what: Read the actual commission or committee agenda and locate the specialized evidence and current study documents
Participate in the actual commission, investigative panel, study group or committee and question the specialized evidence
Evaluate the actual specialized issue and determine the legislator's recommendation within the panel's scope
Explain the recommended action and its reasoning directly to the actual panel or commission

tasks.design: Link the panel agenda and actual study sources in {OTHER}, the commission and committee document system, and {DOCS}. Keep participation, specialized assessment and the actual action recommendation with the legislator.
tasks.previous_blocker: Study documents and testimony references can require separate agenda navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native agenda/source links can remove retrieval without assessing the evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Specialized evidence can be incomplete or contested and the panel's remit can be narrow.
tasks.human_edge: The elected member questions the evidence and takes responsibility for a recommendation.

ambition.what: No automated panel recommendation or decision.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: panel agenda/source links can shorten evidence retrieval while specialized assessment and recommendations remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is actual panel participation and oral action recommendation. No trailing panel report or personal record is invented where none is kept or read. An actual commissioned written report needs its real separate writing and final-version release.
s1 reads the actual study context and verifies source identity; actual testimony is received in s2. No free generated evidence summary substitutes for source examination.
The link removes4 of25 agenda/source navigation units and retains21 for actual reading and checks. Test native panel portals first; existing links earn zero new gain.
Formal votes, filings and operative directions are separate actual actions with real authority. Shares are unmeasured activity estimates.
research_questions: Which source searches remain manual beyond the panel's current document system?

already_counted.description: Actual evidence reading, panel participation, specialized judgment and oral recommendation remain counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R96 gives gross4 less upkeep1, net3. Low: a specialized study uses unindexed appendices, retaining24 of25 retrieval/reading units;1 saved covers1 upkeep, net0. Participation and recommendation judgment remain full.

tasks.short: Vote on committee motions and bill reporting

steps.what: Read the actual motion, amendment or bill-reporting question and verify the exact version before the committee
Participate in the actual debate and consider the arguments and consequences of the voting question
Make the legislator's actual voting decision on the exact current motion, amendment or reporting question
Cast the actual vote on the exact motion, amendment or decision to report the bill out of committee

tasks.design: Link the exact voting question to the actual agenda in {OTHER}, the committee document and voting environment, with text in {DOCS}. The legislator retains source reading, debate, the voting decision and the actual vote.
tasks.previous_blocker: Confirming the current amendment or motion text can require repeated version navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native agenda/version links remove only retrieval, without advising or casting a vote.
tasks.still_hard: The elected member must judge the exact question and its consequences after actual debate.
tasks.human_edge: The legislator exercises the actual voting responsibility directly.

ambition.what: No automated political decision or vote casting.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact agenda/version links can shorten voting-text retrieval while deliberation and actual vote casting remain human.

assumptions: Boundary includes the actual vote rather than stopping at a private opinion. s3 is the real elected member's voting decision, not approval of authored paperwork or an invented supervisor stage.
s1 reads and verifies the actual exact voting question. The link removes2 of25 version-navigation units and retains23 for actual source reading/checking. Existing native links earn zero new gain.

a1 binds the actual decision to the exact current question before s4. Any changed motion, amendment, reporting question or voting decision requires renewed human decision; the helper neither recommends nor casts a vote.

Official vote recording by the clerk or existing voting system is that actual work, not a new focal-role record-writing baseline. No trailing personal vote report or save saving is invented. Shares are unmeasured estimates.
research_questions: Does the current agenda already provide immediate access to the exact voting text?

already_counted.description: Actual voting-text reading, full debate, elected voting decision and vote casting remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: The legislator's actual decision in s3 on the exact current question verified in s1; changed text or decision requires a renewed human decision before the vote.

role.altitude: Political judgment, deliberation, recommendations and voting remain with the elected member; only actual reference navigation and factual brief preparation can shrink.
reach: Work with actual committee and project staff on document versions and funding-case provenance.
role.ambitious_version: A legislator who accesses actual evidence with less repeated navigation while retaining accountable recommendations and direct voting responsibility.
